answer: A rotating public beacon publishes an unpredictable seed each hour; every newcomer must solve a beacon-seeded proof-of-work bound to its long-lived key within a short window, so one operator cannot precompute work for a hollow army of fake identities. Solved keys enter a small oasis of low-value audited jobs, where only verified deliveries earn standing; a failed audit burns the bond and voids the beacon proof. A farm must pay fresh compute plus real work per identity, while honest agents pass once and keep earning.
